headline: Continued public hearings on site plans for 440 Highland Avenue, 11 Summer Street, 370-382 Highland Avenue, and 160 Federal Street.
summary: Four projects will get continued public hearings. They include a Walmart plaza renovation and a 16-unit hotel at 11 Summer Street. The meeting will also consider a member referral for a Design Review Board appointment.
items: Continued public hearing on site plan review for 440 Highland Avenue (Walmart), renovating vacant plaza storefronts
Continued public hearing on site plan review for 11 Summer Street, renovating a building into a 16-unit hotel
Continued public hearing on site plan review for 370-382 Highland Avenue, demolishing two buildings to build a car wash
Continued public hearing on amending a 2020 approval for 160 Federal Street, with changes to landscaping, parking, and a mechanical enclosure
Refer a Planning Board member for appointment to the Design Review Board

Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
 
  
 
 
 
 
NOTICE OF MEETING 
 
Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the Salem Planning Board will be held on  
Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. via remote participation in accordance with Section 
30A of Chapter 20 of the Acts of 2021, as amended by Section 40 of Chapter 2 of the Acts of 
2023, and further amended by Section 1 of Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025. 
 
Kirt Rieder, Chair 
 
 
Important Announcement: 
Every effort will be made to ensure that the public can adequately access the proceedings 
in real time, via technological means. In the event that we are unable to do so on matters 
not requiring a public hearing, we will post on the City of Salem’s website  an audio or 
video recording, transcript, or other comprehensive record of proceedings as soon as 
possible after the meeting. 
 
Individuals may participate remotely in the meeting via a remote participation platform 
called Zoom. Members of the public and/or parties with a right and/or requirement to 
attend this meeting may access the remote participation meeting through any one of the 
following ways: 
 
Watching the Public Meeting: 
• Go to the website link: 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87460376527?pwd=R3ZHWW9wM3k3QXRtSTAzWWdP
WVF6dz09 or 
• Go to the website link www.zoom.us/join and enter meeting ID # 874 6037 6527, 
followed by meeting password 999036, if directed to do so on screen, or 
• Dial toll-free phone number 877-853-5257. When prompted enter meeting ID #  
874 6037 6527, followed by meeting password 999036 if directed. Those dialing in 
only will not have access to the direct video feed of the meeting, but can follow along 
with the project materials available for download at this link 
(https://cityofsalem1.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/PlanningBoard/Eiex2VK4lulDiqWrUC8UoC
YBv2pwr4dBfkRaaUILXEgnog?e=AKzvGG) or 
• Watch the meeting live on Salem Access Television Channel 22. 
 
 
 
 
CITY OF SALEM 
PLANNING BOARD
City of Salem Planning Board 
Agenda for November 19, 2026 
Page 2 of 4 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
Providing Public Comment During the Meeting: 
Members of the public attending this meeting virtually will be allowed to make comments 
during the portion of the hearing designated for each agenda item. Members of the public 
will be asked to use the virtual “Raise Hand” function in Zoom to indicate that they would 
like to provide comment.  
• Dial *9 on your phone’s dial pad to raise your hand if you are using the toll-free 
phone number. 
• Click the “raise hand” button if you are using the Zoom application on your computer 
or phone. 
 
For each agenda item, the moderator will identify attendees with raised hands by their 
screenname or the last 3 digits of their telephone number and will then unmute them. The 
moderator will then request that the attendee unmute their device to provide their full 
name and address if they would like it included in the record and comment for the record. 
The moderator will ensure all public comments are subject to the same time limit. 
 
The moderator will go down the list of attendees with their hands raised in the order 
presented by the Zoom application.  The attendee list is ordered in the order that 
participants raise their hands. 
 
Providing Public Comment Before the Meeting: 
Members of the public can alternatively email their comment before the start of the meeting 
to: planningboardcomments@salem.com 
 
Familiarizing Yourself with Zoom 
We encourage members of the public to install and familiarize themselves with Zoom in 
advance of the meeting. 
 
If you plan on providing public comment and are logging into this meeting via the Zoom 
application, please test your speakers and microphone ahead of time. If we have trouble 
hearing you when you speak, we will move on to the next person and try to return to you 
later in the list. If this happens, we recommend that you call the toll-free number to access 
the meeting and provide your comment. 
 
Persons requiring auxiliary aids and services for effective communication such as sign 
language interpreter, an assistive listening device, or print material in digital format or a 
reasonable modification in programs, services, policies, or activities, may contact the City of 
Salem ADA Coordinator as soon as possible and no less than 2 business days before the 
meeting, program, or event. 
 
The zoom meeting will open 15 minutes before the start of the meeting to allow participants 
to connect and practice with the audio and raise hand functions
City of Salem Planning Board 
Agenda for November 19, 2026 
Page 3 of 4 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
 
MEETING AGENDA 
• Regular Agenda 
 
A. 440 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 4) 
Applicant: Kinetic Design and Development f/b/o Walmart 
Description: A continuation of a public hearing for all persons interested in the application 
of Kinetic Design & Development F/b/o Walmart located at 440 Highland Avenue (Map 3, 
Lot 4) in the Business Park Development District (BPD) and Entrance Corridor Overlay 
District (ECOD) for Site Plan Review and Business Park Development Special Permit in 
accordance with Section 9.5 Site Plan Review and Section 8.3 Business Park Development 
District of the Salem Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes to internally  
renovate and repair the vacant storefronts in the plaza to move their “Spark” program 
Depot from the existing Walmart. No changes to the building footprint are proposed. 
 
B. 11 Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 459), 5-9 Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 461), and 15 
Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 462) 
Applicant: West House LLC, Emmerton House LLC, and Peabody House LLC, 
Description: A continuance of a public hearing for all persons interested in the 
application of West House LLC, Emmerton House LLC, and Peabody House LLC, all d/b/a 
The Salem Inn, located at 5,7,9 Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 459), 11-13 Summer Street 
(Map 26, Lot 461), and 15 Summer Street (Map 26, Lot 462) in the B5 – Central 
Development district and Urban Renewal Overlay for Site Plan Review in accordance 
with Section 9.5 of the Salem Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes the 
renovation of the existing 3 story building at 11 Summer Street to accommodate a hotel 
with 16 units. The applicant is proposing site renovations including an increase of 
parking, through exterior parking changes, and renovations of the existing 2 story 
garage. Other site improvements include landscape improvements, and solar car ports. 
 
C. 370 376 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 63) 378 380 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 64), 
382 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 65)  
Applicant: Joseph Correnti f/b/o GR Development LLC 
Description: A continuation of a public hearing for all persons interested in the application 
Joseph Correnti f/b/o GR Development LLC for the property located at 370 376 Highland 
Avenue (Map 3, Lot 63) 378 380 Highland Avenue (Map 3, Lot 64) and 382 Highland 
Avenue (Map 3, Lot 65) in the (B2) Business Highway and (ECOD) Entrance Corridor 
Overlay District zoning districts for Site Plan Review in accordance with Section 9.5 of the 
Salem Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes to demolish two existing 
buildings onsite, "Puleo's Dairy" and a storage facility, to construct a 4,400 s.f.  car wash 
facility. 24 onsite parking spaces are proposed, 22 of which will also be used as vacuum 
stations.
City of Salem Planning Board 
Agenda for November 19, 2026 
Page 4 of 4 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 2-2033. 
D. 160 Federal Street (Map 26, Lot 2) 
Applicant: North Shore Community Development Coalition 
Description: A continuation of a public hearing for all persons interested in the 
application of North Shore Community Development Coalition located at 160 Federal 
Street (Map 26, Lot 2) in the Residential two-family (R2) district, Coastal Resiliency 
Overlay District (C-ROD), and Flood Hazard Overlay District (FHOD) for Site Plan Review 
and Municipal or Religious Reuse Special Permit in accordance with Section 9.5 and 
Section 6.11 of the Salem Zoning Ordinance. Specifically, the applicant proposes to 
amend the Site Plan Review, Municipal or Religious Reuse Special Permit, and Flood 
Hazard Overlay District Special Permit decision date stamped June 1, 2020 for changes 
related to landscaping and paving materials, parking locations, location of transformer 
and location, height, and size of mechanical enclosure.
